document.publication_date_basis: Live page with no stated date; see retrieval date
document.description: INEC's description of portal services: pre-registration, transfer, information update, PVC collection and replacement.

chunks.text:
INEC Continuous Voter Registration Portal: Services INEC Portal
Continuous Voter Registration Portal
This portal allows you to
Update Your voter registration information,
Transfer your voter registration to another polling unit,
Replace your damaged or lost PVC and find Registration Centres near you to Register for the first time. Services
Get Your Downloadable PVC (Coming soon)
Download a digital copy of your Permanent Voter's Card after a PVC Replacement request. Currently a pilot for eligible Osun State voters. Learn How
New Voter Online Registration
If you have not registered for your voter's card before and would like to do so now, click the button below to start and complete your registration online. Start Registration
New Voter Pre-Registration
If you have not registered for your voter's card before and would like to do so now, click the button below to pre-register and save a lot of time when you visit the Biometric Data Collection Centres.

Voter Information Review
If you have registered and you have not yet reviewed your information by providing your photo online on this platform (or at any registration centre since June 28, 2021), click the button below to begin the process. Start Revalidation Process
Locate Registration Centres
If you wish to visit a Registration Centre to complete your application or registration, there are centres available in INEC State and Local Government Offices and many other locations. Click the button below to find centres closest to you.

Transfers
If you are a duly registered voter and you wish to change your voting location, click the button below to begin the process
Start Transfer Request
Information Update
If you are a duly registered voter and you wish to update the information on your Voter's Card , click the button below to begin the process
Start Update Request
Uncollected PVC
If you have registered previously and you have not gotten your Permanent Voters Card (PVC), click the button below to find out where you can pick your PVC. Check Pickup Locations
Lost or Damaged PVC
If you have misplaced your PVC or if your PVC is damaged and you would like a replacement, click the button below to apply for a re-issue. Submit Request
